question: Who among the following won the men's title in the 77th Senior National Squash Championship, held in February 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sourav Ghosal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Saurav Ghosal** won the **men's title** in the **77th Senior National Squash Championship**.

 
 
• The **championship **was held in **February 2020**.
 
• The **Squash Rackets Federation **of **India **(SRFI)-**77th Senior National squash championships** was held at **Chennai**, **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• Ace Indian squash player **Joshna Chinappa** clinched the **women’s title **by **beating Tanvi Khanna**.
 
• While **Saurav Ghosal **bagged the **men’s title** by **defeating Abhishek Pradhan**.
 
• The champions were awarded** prize money** of Rs. **1,25,000** each.
